description: Guided opt-out fer Cyber Background Checks. A sailor follows the steps on the checklist; OpenOptOut hands over a one-time email address an' clicks any confirmation link.
instructions: Search cyberbackgroundchecks.com fer {full_name}. If ye be listed, open cyberbackgroundchecks.com/removal an' remove the record, giving {contact_email} as the email address. Then smash "I've done this".
